name: DFRobot FireBeetle 2 ESP32-C5 (ESP32-C5-WROOM-1-N4)
radio: the SoC's own radios: wifi24, wifi5, ble, ieee802154

flash.bootloader_instructions: Hold BOOT (GPIO28) while plugging in USB-C, or hold BOOT and tap RST; release after a second. The chip's USB-JTAG-serial port appears.
flash.note: Same chip and module class as the XIAO ESP32C5: kitsune's seeed-xiao-esp32c5 builds are what this target flashes. The bootloader offset 0x2000 is the ESP32-C5 convention, to be confirmed on this board. On the bench at fox-bench since 2026-10-23 (serial over native USB confirmed: the ROM banner 'ESP-ROM:esp32c5-eco2-20250121' prints).

usb.when: ESP32-S3/C5 USB-JTAG-serial (download mode and, with CDC on boot, the running firmware)

pins.name: D13
pins.note: onboard LED (not kitsune's DATA_PIN 27: the XIAO build drives GPIO27, so the status LED does not light on this board)

led.note: onboard LED on GPIO15; the XIAO-C5 build of kitsune drives GPIO27 instead, so expect no status colours on this board until a FireBeetle entry exists in kitsune's rfhsledmacros.h

battery.divider_note: Powered from USB or a 5 V pack. kitsune's note: the pack must not have a low-current cut-off, or the board never wakes from deep sleep.

notes: A stand-in for the Seeed XIAO ESP32C5 target: the firmware image is the same, the LED pin differs.
Serial: native USB CDC (no bridge chip); Listen only shows the ROM banner and kitsune's lines.

serial.notes: kitsune prints 'ESP32 boot count', 'Awake and screaming', 'Going to sleep' and 'PANIC' on its serial port; no command interface.
